title: SDLC Local Config
description: Validates .sdlc-v2/local.toml — user-local (gitignored) configuration for sdlc skills.

reviewSection.description: User-local defaults for the review skill.

scope.description: Which changes to include in the review.

maxDimensions.description: Maximum review dimensions dispatched in one /review run. The most severe are kept. The rest are QUEUED.

planStyleSection.description: User-local plan-only narrative preferences for the plan skill. audience, writingStandard, tone, language, and technicalTerms moved to [style] — they are still accepted here (deprecated) so old files keep validating.

verbosity.description: No longer used; ignored with a warning. Set visualDensity instead.

visualDensity.description: Share of tables, lists, diagrams, and code versus prose in plan narrative sections.

narrativeRules.description: Extra writing rules added to the end of the writing guide.

instructions.description: Custom process instructions /plan shows at start and forwards to every step and subagent, including after context compaction. Default: none.

styleSection.description: User-local communication style shared by every sdlc skill: reader level, writing standard, tone, language, and technical-term allowlist.

audience.description: Who reads skill explanations and plan narrative sections.

writingStandard.description: Sentence rules applied to narrative and chat text.

tone.description: direct enforces banned filler/hedging phrases; neutral does not.

language.description: Language of skill explanations and plan text. Sentence-length limits apply only to English.

technicalTerms.description: Code and product names exempt from the strict STE word checks.

receivedReviewSection.description: User-local defaults for the received-review skill.

alwaysFixSeverities.description: Severities whose 'will fix' findings bypass the per-finding consent gate. Local-only — must NEVER be set in .sdlc-v2/config.toml.

githubSection.description: User-local GitHub account preferences for the pr skill.

expectedAccount.description: Expected gh account login for PR creation. Cascades to git remote origin owner if unset.

executePrefsSection.description: User-local preferences for the execute skill.

auto.description: Whether /execute runs unattended: interactive prompts are suppressed, a feature branch is auto-created when starting on the default branch, and high-risk waves proceed without a second approval. Error-severity guardrail violations still halt execution and are never auto-overridden. Combined by OR with the --auto flag and with a dispatching /ship run's auto mode.

quality.description: Execution quality tier (model preset) applied without presenting /execute's tier-selection prompt. full = Speed (fastest, lightest models, skips the spec-compliance review); balanced = Balanced; minimal = Quality (strongest models, maximum correctness). The --quality flag overrides this. When unset and auto is false, /execute presents the prompt; when unset and auto is true, balanced is used.

highRiskAutoApprove.description: Whether a wave containing a High-risk task proceeds without an approval prompt, on the grounds that the plan was already approved at plan time. Independent of auto: set this alone to keep every other prompt while skipping just the high-risk gate.

steps.description: Pipeline steps to run. Replaces legacy preset/skip fields.

quick.description: Optional shortened step list activated by --quick. When set, /ship --quick uses this list instead of steps[]. Unset means --quick is not available for this project. See R-quick-1.

bump.description: Version bump level. Accepts `major|minor|patch` or any pre-release label matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$` (e.g., `rc`, `beta`, `alpha`). Label values are forwarded to pr_apply as releaseLevel:"patch" plus releasePreRelease:<label>.

draft.description: Open the pull request as a draft.

reviewThreshold.description: Minimum severity level that triggers the review fix loop. Findings below it are deferred, not dropped -- see /sdlc:deferred.

rebase.description: Rebase before ship. true or "auto" rebases without a question, false or "skip" never rebases, "prompt" asks each time.

verifyPipelineTimeout.description: Maximum seconds verify-pipeline polls before giving up with a warning. (R57)

verifyPipelineMaxIterations.description: Maximum analyze-fix-recheck iterations before verify-pipeline emits a warning and proceeds. (R47, R57)

awaitRemoteReviewTimeout.description: Maximum seconds await-remote-review polls before giving up with a warning. (R57)

awaitRemoteReviewers.description: Logins (case-insensitive) whose reviews satisfy await-remote-review. When the login is `copilot`, the reviewer must also be a Bot. (R56, R57)

executeWaveTimeout.description: Maximum seconds a single execute wave may run before stalled tasks are terminated. Forwarded to execute-plan as `--wave-timeout`. The maximum restates MaxWaveTimeoutSeconds in internal/shipmeta/fields.go, which is the single enforcement point (Monitor.timeout_ms caps at 3600000 ms). (R57, R-WAVE-DEADLINE)

executeWaveInterval.description: Seconds between execute wave liveness poll attempts. Forwarded to execute-plan as `--wave-interval`. (R57, R-WAVE-LIVENESS)

automationSection.description: Controls per-step pipeline automation, the review-fix loop, plan-drift halting thresholds, and the end-of-run execution report.

mode.description: Default automation mode for steps not listed in steps{}. "supervised" requires confirmation; "unattended" runs automatically.

reviewFixSeverityThreshold.description: Minimum review-finding severity that triggers a fix attempt.

steps.description: Per-step automation mode overrides, keyed by step name.

drift.description: Rate-based thresholds for halting an unattended run on plan drift (KD-3). The effective threshold is max(minErrorFloor, ceil(rate * totalTasks)).

maxErrorRate.description: Fraction of total tasks that may error before the run halts.

maxWarningRate.description: Fraction of total tasks that may warn before the run halts.

minErrorFloor.description: Minimum absolute error count tolerated regardless of maxErrorRate, so small plans aren't held to an unreachable fractional threshold.

report.description: Controls the execution report emitted at the end of a run (KD-11).

enabled.description: Whether to emit an execution report.

push.description: Controls whether a feature-branch git push during ship is auto-approved without a manual confirmation pause (KD-1). Default-branch (main/master) push is never auto-approved regardless of this setting — ship_prepare hard-gates it server-side.

featureBranchAutoApprove.description: When true, a feature-branch push skips the manual confirmation pause. Forced true at runtime when automation.mode is "unattended", even if explicitly set to false here.

workspaceSection.description: User-local workspace preferences. Workspace itself is auto-detected (branch/continue) — this section only carries branch-name derivation knobs read by the execute skill (plugins/sdlc/skills/execute/SKILL.md, Step 0 workspace auto-detection, "branch" case). The former worktree-placement and mode keys are removed (workspace is no longer user-selectable; fixes #378, #379).

branch.description: Branch-name derivation knobs read by the execute skill (plugins/sdlc/skills/execute/SKILL.md, Step 0 workspace auto-detection, "branch" case), which builds the branch name from them in its own instructions; no Go or JS code reads them. Mirrors workspace.worktree shape. Drives config-driven branch naming in both ship pre-execute block and execute-plan standalone Step 1 (fixes #378, #379).

template.description: Branch name template. Supported placeholders: {type} (mapped via typeMap), {slug} (truncated to slugMaxLength), {issue} (optional ticket key, empty string when not provided), {date} (YYYYMMDD in local tz). Unknown placeholders throw.

slugMaxLength.description: Maximum length of the slug segment before substitution into the template.

typeMap.description: Maps logical plan type to branch prefix. Merged with defaults: {feature:'feat', bugfix:'fix', chore:'chore', docs:'docs', refactor:'refactor'}. Override specific keys to customise prefixes.

dashboardSection.description: Controls the local sdlc dashboard: one web page on this computer that shows the pipelines of every registered repo.

autoStart.description: When true, each Claude session start starts the dashboard server if it is not active, and prints its address.

port.description: Loopback port of the dashboard server. Change it when another program uses 7385.

version.description: Schema version of this local config file. Current version is 2; v1 files (no version field, with ship.preset/ship.skip) are auto-migrated on read.
